readerCopy.body: The inspiring story gets much harder to swallow when the power structure underneath it becomes impossible to ignore. When Neptune opposes Pluto, ideals, compassion, and belief come into direct tension with control, secrecy, money, and whoever actually holds the leverage. The contradiction can expose a widening gap between what people say they are protecting and what their choices allow. You do not have to abandon the value just because the person or institution claiming to represent it has given you a reason to question their motives.
